final_decision.outcome: C — no compact tested model is sufficiently general
final_decision.rationale: H1 fails the 5% acceptance gate and visible-artifact gate. The diagnostic did not authorize arbitrary architecture expansion beyond at most J; the frozen four-pair validation is H0 baseline evidence, with unverified Matrix shot independence and BR geometry below the confirmatory threshold.
final_decision.why_necessary: The observed residual structure and failed H1 gate do not support claiming that a global matrix or an untested extension reconstructs the studio regrade.
final_decision.why_not_more_complex: J was only permitted for clear dual H0/H1 luminance dominance. The gate result above controls this decision; adding hue/chroma/polynomial/LUT/spatial/framewise models would violate the one-shot compact-model protocol and would not repair the missing cross-scene/geometry evidence.
